conventions.wildcards: [*] denotes native identity-bearing array entries; {name} denotes validated dynamic map keys, not arbitrary accepted properties.
conventions.unknown: unverified or null means not established; every row remains open.
conventions.evidence: Source inspection only. No test execution or installed GUI effect is claimed.
conventions.containers: Containers and leaves are separate structural rows; row count is not editable setting count.
conventions.scope: Manifest layers are resolver sources, not proof each field is admitted in each context.
conventions.apply: Only explicit consumer evidence establishes apply class. General runtime acceptance does not prove hot application.
conventions.secrets: Never place secret values in this ledger.
conventions.classification: Manifest-family kind values must equal the NNA classified catalog classification for the same structural path; invocation rows describe accepted CLI option literals from the two NNA option modules. scripts/settings-coverage-gate.mjs enforces both directions and rejects unclassified additions.
